dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently submitted an application for a conventional home improvement loan for $125,000 with a 360-month term. Could you please tell me the current status of my loan application? Has it been approved, denied, or is it still pending?
dialogue.agent: Thank you for your inquiry. Your loan application has been approved and the loan has been originated. If you have any specific questions about your loan terms or details, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know my application was approved. I’d like to know what my interest rate is, and what the total costs of this loan will be.
dialogue.agent: Your approved loan has an interest rate of 8.1%. The total loan costs are not available in your application record. If you have more questions, please let me know.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for providing my interest rate. I have a couple more questions:

Are there any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on my loan? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution yet?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost (HOEPA) mortgage, and it does not have any negative amortization features. According to the record, after origination, your loan was sold to a credit union, mortgage company, or finance company.

dialogue.user: Thank you, that’s very helpful. One last question: what does my debt-to-income ratio mean for my application? Was it a concern in the approval process?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income (DTI) ratio is recorded as between 20% and less than 30%. This means your total monthly debts are less than 30% of your total monthly income. The record does not include any information on whether your DTI was a specific concern or a factor in the approval process.
